evals.prompt: Give me colors for a 5-slice pie chart that a colorblind reader can tell apart. It will go on a slide with a white background.
evals.expected_output: Gives five hex colors from the colorblind-safe set in an order, with label colors and a check.
assertions: Uses a colorblind-safe palette and names it or its source
Specifies label text color or contrast for the slices
Mentions that color should not be the only way to separate slices

evals.prompt: Our handout is printed in black and white. Our brand colors are #1F4E79 and #F2A900. We have 4 categories.
evals.expected_output: Warns brand colors may print as similar grays, suggests distinct grays or labels, uses the brand colors where they differ in lightness.
assertions: Raises that the brand colors may turn into similar grays
Recommends direct labels or patterns in addition to color
Provides hex values for four slices
